Completa con olio e servi caldo.
en: Chop the vegetables.
Cook the ingredients gently in water until tender.
Finish with olive oil and serve hot.

it: Taglia le verdure e prepara i legumi o i cereali.
Cuoci lentamente gli ingredienti in acqua finché sono teneri e i sapori ben amalgamati.
Completa con olio ed erbe e servi caldo.
en: Chop the vegetables and prepare the legumes or grains.
Simmer the ingredients in water until tender and well blended.
Finish with olive oil and herbs and serve hot.
